This plot is small, only 0.31 hectares, and I am growing something other than maize here — I intercrop it to make the land work harder for my family. I have no schooling and little cash, so I cannot buy much fertilizer from the shop. I will put the kraal manure from my goats and chickens on this plot because it costs me nothing, and I will use the seed I saved from last harvest like my father did. My wife and older children will help me weed and harvest, and I may call a neighbor for one or two days during weeding if the rains come strong.
